description: This file declares functions related to Python bindings for tensor types in the Torch library, including initialization, setting default tensor types, and retrieving default tensor properties.

methods.name: initialize_python_bindings
methods.description: Initializes the Python tensor type objects such as torch.FloatTensor and torch.DoubleTensor and binds them in their modules.

methods.name: py_set_default_tensor_type
methods.description: Sets the default tensor type using a PyObject* representing the tensor type.

methods.name: py_set_default_dtype
methods.description: Sets the default ScalarType (dtype) using a PyObject* representing the dtype.

methods.name: get_default_dispatch_key
methods.description: Retrieves the DispatchKey for the default tensor type.

methods.name: get_default_device
methods.description: Retrieves the default device for tensors.

methods.name: get_default_scalar_type
methods.description: Retrieves the ScalarType for the default tensor type.
